optionen: He answered all the questions in the interview honestly.
Honestly, I don't think a gap year is a waste of time.
She has always treated her customers honestly.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Am Satzanfang mit Komma ist honestly ein Satzadverb (ehrlich gesagt); am Satzende beschreibt es, wie jemand handelt.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ist der Satz richtig oder falsch? Achte auf die Bedeutung des Satzadverbs.
aufgabe.satz: Luckily, every hotel in the town was full, so we had to sleep in the car.
loesungen: Unfortunately
Sadly
aufgabe.erklaerung: Im Auto schlafen zu müssen ist Pech: Das Satzadverb muss Unfortunately heißen.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle den richtigen Satz.
loesungen: My aunt sent me a postcard from Australia.
optionen: My aunt sent to me a postcard from Australia.
My aunt sent me a postcard from Australia.
My aunt sent a postcard me from Australia.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Steht die Person direkt nach dem Verb, hat sie kein to: sent me a postcard.

aufgabe.anweisung: Kreuze alle richtigen Sätze an.
loesungen: Our neighbour offered my brother a summer job.
Our neighbour offered a summer job to my brother.
Dad bought my sister a new laptop for university.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Beide Stellungen sind richtig: Person ohne Präposition vorn oder Sache vorn und Person mit to/for dahinter – aber nie to + Person vor der Sache.
optionen: Our neighbour offered my brother a summer job.
Our neighbour offered to my brother a summer job.
Our neighbour offered a summer job to my brother.
Dad bought my sister a new laptop for university.
Dad bought to my sister a new laptop for university.

aufgabe.anweisung: Sortiere die Verben: Steht die Person mit to oder mit for, wenn die Sache zuerst kommt?
loesungen: mit to (give a book to sb): give, send, show, lend | mit for (buy a book for sb): buy, make, cook, find
aufgabe.erklaerung: Bei give, send, show und lend geht etwas an die Person (to); bei buy, make, cook und find tut man etwas für sie (for).
gruppen: mit to (give a book to sb)
mit for (buy a book for sb)

elemente.text: give
buy
send
make
show
cook
lend
find

aufgabe.anweisung: Markiere in beiden Sätzen die Person, die etwas bekommt.
aufgabe.satz: My uncle gave Lisa his old bike. Later he sent Tom some money for his trip.
loesungen: Lisa | Tom
aufgabe.erklaerung: Die Person steht ohne Präposition direkt nach dem Verb (gave Lisa, sent Tom), danach folgt die Sache.

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde einen Satz aus den Teilen.
loesungen: My parents gave me a watch for my birthday.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Ohne to steht die Person direkt nach dem Verb: gave me a watch.

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde einen Satz aus den Teilen.
loesungen: The manager offered Leo a job at the hotel.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Person ohne Präposition, dann die Sache: offered Leo a job.

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde eine Frage aus den Teilen.
loesungen: Could you lend me your laptop for an hour?
aufgabe.erklaerung: lend + Person + Sache: lend me your laptop.

aufgabe.anweisung: Schreibe den Satz so um, dass die Sache zuerst kommt. Beginne mit dem Satzanfang.
aufgabe.satz: Emma sent her grandparents a postcard from Spain.
loesungen: Emma sent a postcard to her grandparents from Spain.
Emma sent a postcard from Spain to her grandparents.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Kommt die Sache zuerst, folgt die Person mit to: a postcard to her grandparents.

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde die Frage nach der Person, die etwas gegeben hat.
aufgabe.satz: My aunt gave me this watch.
loesungen: Who gave you this watch?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Fragt man nach dem Subjekt, bleibt die Stellung: gave you this watch.

aufgabe.anweisung: Schreibe den Satz so um, dass die Person direkt nach dem Verb steht – ohne for.
aufgabe.satz: Her teacher will write a reference for her.
loesungen: Her teacher will write her a reference.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Steht die Person direkt nach dem Verb, fällt for weg: write her a reference.
aufgabe.kontext: Lucy is applying for a scholarship, and her teacher is going to help her.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle den richtigen Satz.
loesungen: Yesterday the manager showed me the kitchen and gave me a list of my tasks.
optionen: Yesterday the manager showed to me the kitchen and gave me a list of my tasks.
Yesterday the manager showed me the kitchen and gave me a list of my tasks.
Yesterday the manager showed me the kitchen and gave to me a list of my tasks.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Person ohne to direkt nach dem Verb: showed me …, gave me …
aufgabe.kontext: Mia is volunteering at a hostel in Edinburgh. She writes to her parents about her first day.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle den richtigen Satz.
loesungen: The guide explained the history of the castle to us.
optionen: The guide explained us the history of the castle.
The guide explained the history of the castle to us.
The guide explained the history of the castle us.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Bei explain steht die Person immer mit to hinter der Sache: explained the history … to us.

aufgabe.anweisung: Finde das falsche Verb und berichtige es.
aufgabe.satz: My grandparents have gave me some money for my gap year.
loesungen: given
aufgabe.erklaerung: Nach have folgt das Partizip: have given me some money.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle den richtigen Satz.
loesungen: The project leader sent all the new volunteers an email with useful information about the camp.
optionen: The project leader sent to all the new volunteers an email with useful information about the camp.
The project leader sent an email all the new volunteers with useful information about the camp.
The project leader sent all the new volunteers an email with useful information about the camp.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Person ohne to direkt nach dem Verb, dann die Sache: sent all the new volunteers an email.

aufgabe.anweisung: Kreuze alle richtigen Sätze an.
loesungen: The careers advisor gave each student a list of companies that offer internships.
Last year the charity offered three young people from our town a scholarship.
Could you explain to me how the application process works?
aufgabe.erklaerung: give und offer erlauben die Person direkt nach dem Verb; explain braucht immer to + Person; to + Person vor der Sache (showed to me the best places) ist falsch.
optionen: The careers advisor gave each student a list of companies that offer internships.
Last year the charity offered three young people from our town a scholarship.
The manager explained the new staff how the machines work.
Could you explain to me how the application process works?
My host family showed to me the best places to eat in town.

aufgabe.anweisung: Sortiere die Sätze: richtig oder falsch?
loesungen: richtig: The hotel offered the guests a free breakfast because of the noise., Could you explain the way to the station to us?, My boss has promised me more money if I work at weekends., She read the children a story before they went to bed. | falsch: The hotel offered to the guests a free dinner because of the noise., Could you suggest us a good restaurant near the station?, Mr Clark explained us why the trip had been cancelled., He bought for his parents a weekend in Paris.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Falsch sind to/for + Person vor der Sache und explain/suggest mit der Person direkt nach dem Verb.

elemente.text: The hotel offered the guests a free breakfast because of the noise.
The hotel offered to the guests a free dinner because of the noise.
Could you explain the way to the station to us?
Could you suggest us a good restaurant near the station?
My boss has promised me more money if I work at weekends.
Mr Clark explained us why the trip had been cancelled.
She read the children a story before they went to bed.
He bought for his parents a weekend in Paris.

aufgabe.anweisung: Markiere in beiden Sätzen das Nomen für die Sache, die jemand bekommt.
aufgabe.satz: The museum offered the students a discount. Later, the guide showed them a short film about the city.
loesungen: discount | film
aufgabe.erklaerung: Zuerst steht die Person (the students, them), danach die Sache (a discount, a short film).

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde einen Satz aus den Teilen.
loesungen: The university sent me an offer last week.
Last week the university sent me an offer.
Last week, the university sent me an offer.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Ohne to steht die Person direkt nach dem Verb: sent me an offer.

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde einen Satz aus den Teilen.
loesungen: My host mother taught me a few Spanish phrases in my first week.
aufgabe.erklaerung: teach + Person + Sache: taught me a few Spanish phrases.

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde einen Satz aus den Teilen.
loesungen: The charity has promised the families new homes by the end of the year.
teile: by the end of the year.
aufgabe.erklaerung: promise + Person + Sache: promised the families new homes.

aufgabe.anweisung: Schreibe den Satz so um, dass die Sache zuerst kommt. Beginne mit dem Satzanfang.
aufgabe.satz: The hotel manager handed the guests their keys.
loesungen: The hotel manager handed their keys to the guests.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Kommt die Sache zuerst, folgt die Person mit to: their keys to the guests.
aufgabe.anfang: The hotel manager handed their keys

aufgabe.anweisung: Schreibe den Satz so um, dass die Person direkt nach dem Verb steht.
aufgabe.satz: She gave some really useful tips to him.
loesungen: She gave him some really useful tips.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Person direkt nach dem Verb ohne to: gave him some really useful tips.
aufgabe.kontext: Amir's teacher is helping him with his scholarship application.

aufgabe.anweisung: Frage nach der Sache, die Sophie angeboten wurde.
aufgabe.satz: The company offered Sophie a job in their London office.
loesungen: What did the company offer Sophie?
What did the company offer to Sophie?
What was Sophie offered?
What was Sophie offered by the company?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Fragt man nach der Sache, bleibt die Person hinter dem Verb: What did the company offer Sophie?

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle den richtigen Satz.
loesungen: A farmer offered me a job and lent me his old car for the summer.
optionen: A farmer offered me a job and lent to me his old car for the summer.
A farmer offered to me a job and lent me his old car for the summer.
A farmer offered me a job and lent me his old car for the summer.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Person ohne to direkt nach dem Verb: offered me a job, lent me his old car.
aufgabe.kontext: Tom writes in his blog about his gap year in Australia.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle den richtigen Satz.
loesungen: Before we went in, the tour guide described the old town to us.
optionen: Before we went in, the tour guide described us the old town.
Before we went in, the tour guide described the old town to us.
Before we went in, the tour guide described the old town us.
aufgabe.erklaerung: describe erlaubt keine Person direkt nach dem Verb: described the old town to us.

aufgabe.anweisung: Finde das falsche Verb und berichtige es.
aufgabe.satz: Has the bank already sended you the new card for your account?
loesungen: sent
aufgabe.erklaerung: send ist unregelmäßig: has sent you the new card.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle den richtigen Satz.
loesungen: Before she left for her year in Chile, her grandparents gave her a small diary to write down her experiences.
optionen: Before she left for her year in Chile, her grandparents gave to her a small diary to write down her experiences.
Before she left for her year in Chile, her grandparents gave her a small diary to write down her experiences.
Before she left for her year in Chile, her grandparents gave a small diary her to write down her experiences.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Person ohne to direkt nach dem Verb, dann die Sache: gave her a small diary.

aufgabe.anweisung: Kreuze alle richtigen Sätze an.
loesungen: The charity has offered twenty students from poorer areas a place on its summer programme.
Could you explain to the new volunteers what they have to do on their first day?
They owe their success to the support of their families.
aufgabe.erklaerung: offer erlaubt die Person direkt nach dem Verb, explain und owe die Form mit to; suggest nie mit Person direkt nach dem Verb, und to + Person vor der Sache ist falsch.
optionen: The charity has offered twenty students from poorer areas a place on its summer programme.
Could you explain to the new volunteers what they have to do on their first day?
The head teacher suggested the students a different topic for their project.
They owe their success to the support of their families.
We will send to all applicants a confirmation by email.

aufgabe.anweisung: Sortiere die Sätze: richtig oder falsch?
loesungen: richtig: The university has sent every applicant a detailed plan of the course., Would you mind explaining the difference to me again?, Her teachers had found her a place at a school in Dublin before she even arrived., We owe our host family a big thank-you for everything they did. | falsch: The college has sent to every applicant a detailed plan of the course., Would you mind explaining me the difference once more?, The company has described us the job in great detail., The coach bought to each player a new shirt after the final.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Falsch sind to/for + Person vor der Sache sowie explain/describe mit der Person direkt nach dem Verb.

elemente.text: The university has sent every applicant a detailed plan of the course.
The college has sent to every applicant a detailed plan of the course.
Would you mind explaining the difference to me again?
Would you mind explaining me the difference once more?
Her teachers had found her a place at a school in Dublin before she even arrived.
The company has described us the job in great detail.
We owe our host family a big thank-you for everything they did.
The coach bought to each player a new shirt after the final.

aufgabe.anweisung: Markiere die drei Wörter für die Personen, die etwas bekommen.
aufgabe.satz: During my internship, my manager gave me a lot of responsibility. She also taught Lukas some useful computer skills and later wrote Ana a great reference.
loesungen: me | Lukas | Ana
aufgabe.erklaerung: Die Person steht ohne Präposition direkt nach dem Verb (gave me, taught Lukas, wrote Ana), dann folgt die Sache.

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde einen Satz aus den Teilen.
loesungen: After six weeks the embassy has finally sent Paolo his visa.
After six weeks, the embassy has finally sent Paolo his visa.
aufgabe.erklaerung: send + Person + Sache: sent Paolo his visa; finally steht nach has.

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde einen Satz aus den Teilen.
loesungen: Every year the foundation offers the best students a scholarship to study in the USA.
Every year, the foundation offers the best students a scholarship to study in the USA.
aufgabe.erklaerung: offer + Person + Sache ohne Präposition: offers the best students a scholarship.

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde einen Satz aus den Teilen.
loesungen: My grandfather never told us the whole story of his escape.
aufgabe.erklaerung: tell + Person + Sache: told us the whole story.

aufgabe.anweisung: Die Person ist sehr lang. Schreibe den Satz so um, dass die Sache zuerst kommt. Beginne mit dem Satzanfang.
aufgabe.satz: The festival team gave every volunteer who had worked there for more than a week a free ticket.
loesungen: The festival team gave a free ticket to every volunteer who had worked there for more than a week.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Eine lange Personenangabe steht besser am Ende – mit to: a free ticket to every volunteer who …
aufgabe.anfang: The festival team gave a free ticket

aufgabe.anweisung: Schreibe den Satz so um, dass die Person direkt nach dem Verb steht.
aufgabe.satz: I would be very grateful if you could send more information about the programme to me.
loesungen: I would be very grateful if you could send me more information about the programme.
I'd be very grateful if you could send me more information about the programme.
aufgabe.erklaerung: send + Person + Sache: send me more information.
aufgabe.kontext: Leonie writes a formal email to an organisation that offers gap year projects.

aufgabe.anweisung: Frage nach der Sache, die den Freiwilligen versprochen wurde.
aufgabe.satz: They promised the volunteers free accommodation in return for their help.
loesungen: What did they promise the volunteers in return for their help?
What did they promise to the volunteers in return for their help?
What did they promise the volunteers?
What did they promise to the volunteers?
What were the volunteers promised in return for their help?
What were the volunteers promised?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Fragt man nach der Sache, bleibt die Person direkt hinter dem Verb: What did they promise the volunteers?

aufgabe.anweisung: Ergänze die Person in Klammern im Satz und schreibe den ganzen Satz.
aufgabe.satz: Before the interview started, the manager described the job in detail.
loesungen: Before the interview started, the manager described the job to Mark in detail.
Before the interview started, the manager described the job in detail to Mark.
Before the interview started the manager described the job to Mark in detail.
Before the interview started the manager described the job in detail to Mark.
aufgabe.erklaerung: describe verlangt to + Person hinter der Sache: described the job to Mark.
aufgabe.kontext: Mark applied for a job at a hotel in Brighton.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle den richtigen Satz.
loesungen: Could you explain to me why the university has rejected my application?
optionen: Could you explain me why the university has rejected my application?
Could you explain to me why the university has rejected my application?
Could you explain why to me the university has rejected my application?
aufgabe.erklaerung: explain braucht immer to vor der Person; bei einem Nebensatz als Sache steht to me davor: explain to me why …

aufgabe.anweisung: Finde das falsche Verb und berichtige es.
aufgabe.satz: My flatmate has lended me her bike for the whole summer, so I can cycle to work.
loesungen: lent
aufgabe.erklaerung: lend ist unregelmäßig: has lent me her bike.

aufgabe.anweisung: Welcher Satz ist richtig?
loesungen: Tom was offered a scholarship by a university in Scotland.
optionen: To Tom was offered a scholarship by a university in Scotland.
Tom was offered a scholarship by a university in Scotland.
It was offered Tom a scholarship by a university in Scotland.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Im Passiv wird die Person Subjekt: Tom was offered … – ohne to und ohne it.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ordne jedem Aktivsatz den passenden Passivsatz zu.
loesungen: The charity offers Lena an internship. Lena is offered an internship. | The charity offered Lena an internship. Lena was offered an internship. | The charity has offered Lena an internship. Lena has been offered an internship. | The charity will offer Lena an internship. Lena will be offered an internship.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Die Zeitform bleibt gleich: offers → is offered, offered → was offered, has offered → has been offered, will offer → will be offered.

paare.links: The charity offers Lena an internship.
paare.rechts: Lena is offered an internship.

paare.links: The charity offered Lena an internship.
paare.rechts: Lena was offered an internship.

paare.links: The charity has offered Lena an internship.
paare.rechts: Lena has been offered an internship.

paare.links: The charity will offer Lena an internship.
paare.rechts: Lena will be offered an internship.

aufgabe.anweisung: Markiere die beiden Wörter der Passivform (Hilfsverb und Partizip).
aufgabe.satz: After the interview, Jonas was given some useful tips for his CV.
loesungen: was | given
aufgabe.erklaerung: was given ist das Passiv von give; die Person Jonas ist Subjekt.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ist der Satz richtig oder falsch?
aufgabe.satz: Ben was sent an email about his visa yesterday.
loesungen: Ben was sent an email about his visa yesterday.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Richtig: Die Person Ben ist Subjekt, danach folgt die Sache – was sent an email.

aufgabe.anweisung: Schreibe den Satz im Passiv. Beginne mit der Person und lass den Handelnden weg.
aufgabe.satz: The university offered Anna a scholarship.
loesungen: Anna was offered a scholarship.
aufgabe.erklaerung: offered (simple past) → was offered; die Person Anna wird Subjekt.

aufgabe.anweisung: Bring die Teile in die richtige Reihenfolge.
loesungen: On the first day the volunteers were given a map of the town.
On the first day, the volunteers were given a map of the town.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Person als Subjekt + were given + Sache: the volunteers were given a map.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb im Passiv ein (simple past).
aufgabe.satz: Last year Sara ___ a place on a volunteer project in Kenya.
loesungen: was offered
aufgabe.erklaerung: Sara bekommt das Angebot, sie ist Subjekt: was offered a place.

aufgabe.anweisung: Stelle die Frage nach der Sache. Benutze das Passiv.
aufgabe.satz: She was offered a job at the animal charity.
loesungen: What was she offered?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Frage im Passiv: What + was + Subjekt + offered?

aufgabe.anweisung: Schreibe den Satz im Passiv. Beginne mit der Person und lass den Handelnden weg.
aufgabe.satz: A school in Ghana offered Jack a job as a teaching assistant.
loesungen: Jack was offered a job as a teaching assistant.
aufgabe.erklaerung: offered → was offered; Jack ist Subjekt, die Sache a job folgt direkt.
aufgabe.kontext: Jack wants to work abroad in his gap year. Yesterday he got a phone call.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ergänze die E-Mail. Setze die Verben im Passiv ein; die Person ist jeweils Subjekt.
aufgabe.satz: Hi Grandma! My first week in Canada has been great. On Monday I ___ the hospital where I volunteer. The staff are really friendly, and yesterday I ___ my own small team. Tomorrow we ___ our plans for the next month. I'm a bit homesick, but I have already ___ lots of photos by my host family. Love, Ella
loesungen: was shown | was given | will be told | been sent
aufgabe.erklaerung: On Monday/yesterday → was shown, was given; tomorrow → will be told; have already → been sent.

loesungen: was shown
was given
will be told
are going to be told
are being told
been sent

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb im Passiv ein. Achte auf das Signalwort in der Klammer.
aufgabe.satz: He ___ a scholarship, so he can study in Boston next year!
loesungen: has just been given
's just been given
aufgabe.erklaerung: just → present perfect; Passiv mit der Person als Subjekt: has just been given.
aufgabe.kontext: Max has applied to a university in the USA. He is opening a letter from them right now.

aufgabe.anweisung: Welcher Satz ist richtig?
loesungen: The applicants were shown the new office after the interview.
optionen: To the applicants were shown the new office after the interview.
The applicants were shown the new office after the interview.
It was shown the applicants the new office after the interview.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Die Personen (the applicants) werden Subjekt: were shown the new office.

aufgabe.anweisung: Finde das falsche Wort und berichtige es.
aufgabe.satz: My brother was give a great reference by his last employer.
loesungen: given
aufgabe.erklaerung: Passiv = be + Partizip: was given.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ordne jedem Aktivsatz den passenden Passivsatz zu.
loesungen: Someone is telling the new volunteers the house rules. The new volunteers are being told the house rules. | Someone had told the new volunteers the house rules. The new volunteers had been told the house rules. | Someone must tell the new volunteers the house rules. The new volunteers must be told the house rules. | Someone told the new volunteers the house rules. The new volunteers were told the house rules.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Die Zeitform bleibt: is telling → are being told, had told → had been told, must tell → must be told, told → were told.

paare.links: Someone is telling the new volunteers the house rules.
paare.rechts: The new volunteers are being told the house rules.

paare.links: Someone had told the new volunteers the house rules.
paare.rechts: The new volunteers had been told the house rules.

paare.links: Someone must tell the new volunteers the house rules.
paare.rechts: The new volunteers must be told the house rules.

paare.links: Someone told the new volunteers the house rules.
paare.rechts: The new volunteers were told the house rules.

aufgabe.anweisung: Markiere alle Wörter der beiden Passivformen (ohne already).
aufgabe.satz: When Leon arrived in Peru, he had already been sent a list of useful phrases. On his first day he was shown the school where he would teach.
loesungen: had | been | sent | was | shown
aufgabe.erklaerung: had been sent (past perfect) und was shown (simple past) sind Passivformen; Subjekt ist jeweils die Person he.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ist der Satz richtig oder falsch?
aufgabe.satz: Because Nora lacked work experience, she was offered a three-month internship instead of a job.
loesungen: Because Nora lacked work experience, she was offered a three-month internship instead of a job.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Richtig: Die Person she ist Subjekt, die Sache folgt direkt – was offered an internship.

aufgabe.anweisung: Kreuze alle richtigen Sätze an.
loesungen: Several students have been offered scholarships by universities abroad.
The visitors were being shown the old harbour when it started to rain.
My cousin is being sent a new visa because the old one got lost.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Richtig ist immer die Person als Subjekt; *To several students … und *It was told the volunteers … gibt es nicht.
optionen: Several students have been offered scholarships by universities abroad.
To several students have been offered scholarships by universities abroad.
The visitors were being shown the old harbour when it started to rain.
It was told the volunteers that their trip had changed.
My cousin is being sent a new visa because the old one got lost.

aufgabe.anweisung: Schreibe den Satz im Passiv. Beginne mit der Person und lass den Handelnden weg.
aufgabe.satz: The organisation will send every volunteer a welcome pack before they leave.
loesungen: Every volunteer will be sent a welcome pack before they leave.
aufgabe.erklaerung: will send → will be sent; every volunteer wird Subjekt.

aufgabe.anweisung: Schreibe den Satz im Passiv. Beginne mit der Person und lass den Handelnden weg.
aufgabe.satz: Someone is showing the new workers how the machines work.
loesungen: The new workers are being shown how the machines work.
aufgabe.erklaerung: is showing (present progressive) → are being shown.

aufgabe.anweisung: Bring die Teile in die richtige Reihenfolge.
loesungen: Last year more than 200 young people were given the chance to volunteer abroad.
Last year, more than 200 young people were given the chance to volunteer abroad.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Person als Subjekt + were given + Sache (the chance).

aufgabe.anweisung: Frage nach der Person. Benutze das Passiv.
aufgabe.satz: Ryan has been offered a job in a hotel in Edinburgh.
loesungen: Who has been offered a job in a hotel in Edinburgh?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Fragt man nach dem Subjekt, bleibt die Satzstellung: Who has been offered …?

aufgabe.anweisung: Ergänze den Dialog. Setze die Verben im Passiv ein; die Person ist jeweils Subjekt.
aufgabe.satz:
A: How was your first week at the newspaper?
B: Great! On Monday I ___ my own desk, and then I ___ how the website works.
A: Have you written anything yet?

aufgabe.erklaerung: had been criticised, was published, was done und have been changed sind Passivformen; seem ist Aktiv.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ordne jeder Situation den Satz zu, der sie genau wiedergibt.
loesungen: We are sure that somebody took the visas by mistake. The visas must have been taken by mistake. | It was wrong that nobody checked the visas before the trip. The visas should have been checked before the trip. | Perhaps somebody sent the visas to the wrong address, but we don't know. The visas might have been sent to the wrong address. | Today it is possible for anyone to check the visas online. The visas can be checked online today.
aufgabe.erklaerung: must have been = sichere Vermutung, should have been = Kritik, might have been = Möglichkeit (alle Vergangenheit); can be = Möglichkeit in der Gegenwart.

paare.links: We are sure that somebody took the visas by mistake.
paare.rechts: The visas must have been taken by mistake.

paare.links: It was wrong that nobody checked the visas before the trip.
paare.rechts: The visas should have been checked before the trip.

paare.links: Perhaps somebody sent the visas to the wrong address, but we don't know.
paare.rechts: The visas might have been sent to the wrong address.

paare.links: Today it is possible for anyone to check the visas online.
paare.rechts: The visas can be checked online today.

aufgabe.anweisung: Kreuze alle Sätze an, die den Aktivsatz richtig ins Passiv setzen: The company offered Liam a well-paid job in the city.
loesungen: Liam was offered a well-paid job in the city.
A well-paid job in the city was offered to Liam.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Bei offer sb sth kann die Person (Liam was offered …) oder die Sache Subjekt werden (… was offered to Liam).
optionen: Liam was offered a well-paid job in the city.
A well-paid job in the city was offered to Liam.
Liam was offered to a well-paid job in the city.
Liam has offered a well-paid job in the city.
To Liam was offered a well-paid job in the city.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ist der Satz richtig oder falsch? Wenn er falsch ist, berichtige das falsche Wort.
aufgabe.satz: The new law, which is expected to be passed next month, will make it easier for young people to get a work visa.
loesungen: The new law, which is expected to be passed next month, will make it easier for young people to get a work visa.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Richtig: is expected + Passiv-Infinitiv to be passed (das Gesetz wird verabschiedet).

aufgabe.anweisung: Forme ins Passiv um. Behalte die Zeitform bei.
aufgabe.satz: Researchers are currently studying the effects of gap years on young people's careers.
loesungen: The effects of gap years on young people's careers are currently being studied.
The effects of gap years on young people's careers are currently being studied by researchers.
The effects of gap years on young people's careers are being studied by researchers.
The effects of gap years on young people's careers are being studied.
aufgabe.erklaerung: are studying → are being studied (Passiv Verlaufsform).
aufgabe.anfang: The effects of gap years on young people's careers

aufgabe.anweisung: Forme den Satz mit should und Passiv um.
aufgabe.satz: It was a mistake that nobody told the volunteers about the risks before they left.
loesungen: The volunteers should have been told about the risks before they left.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Kritik an der Vergangenheit, Personen als Empfänger: should have been told.

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde die Frage nach dem Zeitpunkt.
aufgabe.satz: The new hospital is going to be opened at the end of the month.
loesungen: When is the new hospital going to be opened?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Frage mit going to im Passiv: When is + Subjekt + going to be + 3. Form?

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde einen Satz.
loesungen: The letter with my new passport is supposed to have been delivered yesterday.
aufgabe.erklaerung: be supposed + Perfekt-Passiv-Infinitiv: Der Brief hätte gestern zugestellt werden sollen.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ergänze den Artikel. Setze die Verben in der passenden Passivform ein.
aufgabe.satz: Volunteering abroad has become big business. Every year, thousands of young people ___ high fees to work on projects they lack the skills for. In some cases, schools that ___ by volunteers had to be pulled down later because they were not safe. Many people argue that local workers should ___ instead. At present, new rules for such programmes ___ by the government, and organisations that break them ___ to lose their licence.
loesungen: are charged | had been built | be employed | are being discussed | are expected
aufgabe.erklaerung: Every year → are charged; vor dem Abriss → had been built; should + Passiv-Infinitiv; At present → are being discussed; are expected to …

loesungen: are charged
had been built
were built
be employed
have been employed
are being discussed
are expected

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb in der passenden Passivform ein.
aufgabe.satz: Everybody now agrees that the accident could easily ___.
loesungen: have been avoided
aufgabe.erklaerung: Nicht genutzte Möglichkeit in der Vergangenheit im Passiv: could have been + 3. Form.
aufgabe.kontext: The accident on the building site happened because the workers had no helmets. The company had known about the problem for months.

aufgabe.anweisung: Forme den Satz um. Beginne mit dem vorgegebenen Satzanfang.
aufgabe.satz: People expect that the government will introduce new visa rules next year.
loesungen: New visa rules are expected to be introduced next year.
New visa rules are expected to be introduced by the government next year.
New visa rules are expected to be introduced next year by the government.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Zwei Schritte: People expect → are expected to; die Regeln werden eingeführt → Passiv-Infinitiv to be introduced.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ordne jeder Situation den Satz zu, der sie genau wiedergibt.
loesungen: Everyone is completely sure that Maya will get the scholarship. Maya is certain to be given the scholarship. | There is a good chance that Maya will get the scholarship, but it is not sure yet. Maya is likely to be given the scholarship. | According to the rules, Maya should get the scholarship, but it may not happen. Maya is supposed to be given the scholarship. | People say that Maya got the scholarship two years ago. Maya is said to have been given the scholarship.
aufgabe.erklaerung: be certain to = ganz sicher, be likely to = wahrscheinlich, be supposed to = so ist es vorgesehen; is said to have been given = man sagt, es geschah früher.

aufgabe.satz: The fire in the hostel is thought to has been started by a candle, although the police are still investigating.
loesungen: have
aufgabe.erklaerung: Nach to steht immer die Grundform: is thought to have been started.
